class_id: a retry ceiling parks an item and overwrites the cause, so nobody can tell a transient failure from a verdict on the item
feature: any retry ladder whose ceiling converts N failures into a terminal or operator-cleared state (extraction MANUAL_REVIEW blocks, dead-letter queues, circuit breakers keyed on an item)
symptom: the ladder counts every failure the same way, whether it is a verdict on the item (a parse error, an unsupported format) or a statement about the environment (our own spawn clock expired, the kernel could not start a process, the box was contended). After N failures the item is parked in a state that only a code change or an operator clears. Environment failures cluster: a busy box, a too-short timeout or a noisy neighbour produces the N failures in a row on an item that would succeed on the next quiet run, so the ceiling turns a temporary condition into a permanent loss of that item. The ceiling also overwrites the last cause with its own marker, so once parked nobody can tell from the row which kind of failure put it there.
first_seen: 2026-09-10 / 2026-09-18 -- IPODhan staging, read-only 2026-09-26. Six documents carry `blocked_after_10_attempts@extract_filing.py@2026-09-03` (MANUAL_REVIEW, retry_count 10). Two were blocked by a transient failure on the 10th attempt: ESDS Software RHP edc03a70 (21.9 MB), `spawn failed: spawnSync nice ETIMEDOUT` under the then 10-minute EXTRACT_TIMEOUT_MS (#583 log line 2026-09-10T18:35:16Z), and National Stock Exchange of India ANCHOR_ALLOCATION_REPORT 09f303fa, `anchor sidecar timed out after 120000ms` (wake log 2026-09-18T03:18:27Z; its history mixes timeouts with `ONNXRuntimeError` sidecar failures). The other four (PRICE_BAND_AD on swastika-infra, adroit-industries, moneyview; ANCHOR_ALLOCATION_REPORT on shanti-inorganics) have no recorded cause: the block marker overwrote extraction_error, `document_extraction_attempts` (migration 0065) is not applied on staging, and the retained logs carry no failure line for them. #396 (same ETIMEDOUT, prod, 2026-09-07) was closed by a detector only.
fix_prs: #1190 (Refs #583), round 2. Every failure kind still counts toward the 10-attempt limit and every kind is blocked there (no unbounded retry: OD-21, OD-33, §5.3 step 5 'never on a backoff timer'). The block marker now keeps the kind and last cause: `blocked_after_10_attempts kind=<transient:spawn_timeout|transient:spawn_resource|transient:sidecar_timeout|hard|persist_error|deterministic> last=<cause> @<version>`, with the version still the last token so parseBlockedVersion and the version-change unblock work unchanged. Filing and anchor spawns share one classifier (`classifySpawnErrorCode`: ETIMEDOUT=spawn_timeout, EAGAIN/ENOMEM/EMFILE/ENFILE=spawn_resource). Recovery is the spec's triggers only: an extractor version change (built, documentExtractionBlocked transition 6); a newer document type (a new row, extracted on its own, does NOT unblock the old one; nothing built); the re-read loop (withdrawn by OD-65/OD-66). Existing rows are not repaired here; the 6 staging rows encode @2026-09-03 and are already eligible under the served 2026-09-26 version.
detection_check: m_extraction_stuck 5th shape (#583): any document type (ANCHOR_ALLOCATION_REPORT and PRICE_BAND_AD included) on a live IPO at the retry ceiling (blocked marker or retry_count >= 10) is reported at ANY updated_at age, with ipo id, document id, type, kind and last cause. A legacy bare-marker row is reported as kind=unrecorded.
